name: Semantic Voxel Labelling
aliases: Closed-Set Semantic Fusion via Dirichlet-Categorical Conjugacy
definition: Predicting class labels for each voxel in an input grid, where every 3D voxel is assigned an integer class label indicating its semantic category.
summary: Semantic Voxel Labelling assigns deterministic integer class labels to every voxel in a 3D grid, providing discrete identifiers for downstream tasks rather than continuous optical properties.
